warnings: This source is an informational guide about NJ landlord-tenant law procedures and agency contacts, not a text stating operative rules in the six categories.

The foreclosure section describes notice requirements and tenant protections during foreclosure, but does not impose rent increase limits, just-cause eviction grounds, security deposit rules, application fee caps, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent-setting bans.

Senior citizen/disabled tenant protected tenancy and conversion protections are mentioned but the source does not specify the operative rent, eviction, or deposit rules—it refers readers to separate statutes (N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.22 et seq.) and forms.
